title: AIIMS New Delhi admissions: routes by course
content:
# AIIMS New Delhi admissions: routes by course

## MBBS
Admission is 'based on merit through the National Eligibility Entrance Test (NEET) conducted by the National Testing Agency' (since 2020). Intake: **125 Indian students** plus **7 foreign nationals** a year. Course: 5½ years including internship. Seat allotment for NEET is through central counselling; check the NEET/MCC notices.

## B.Sc nursing and paramedical
B.Sc (Hons) Nursing, B.Sc Nursing (Post-certificate), B.Sc (Hons) Medical Technology in Radiography, B.Sc (Hons) Ophthalmic Techniques, B.Sc Operation Theatre Technology, B.Sc Dental Hygiene and B.Sc Dental Operating Room Assistant. Entrance notices are on https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in.

## Postgraduate and doctoral
All postgraduate admissions (PhD, DM, MCh, MD, MS, MDS) are through an **All-India entrance examination held twice a year**; MSc, MSc Nursing and M.Biotechnology are admitted **once a year**. Foreign nationals are admitted in a sponsored category through the same exam. Exam names, eligibility, fees and dates are in each exam's notice on https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in/landingpage/notice.

## Dates
The tentative schedule of entrance examinations is at https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in/landingpage/key-dates (calendars for 2025 and 2027 are linked there).

title: AIIMS New Delhi academic programmes and grievance contacts
content:
# AIIMS New Delhi academic programmes and grievance contacts

The Academic Section runs undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in medical, nursing and paramedical fields (page last updated 8 May 2023; student figures are for 2020-21).

## MBBS structure
5½ years: Phase I pre-clinical (1 year), Phase II para-clinical (1½ years), Phase III clinical (2 years), then a 1-year internship.

## Other programmes
B.Sc nursing and paramedical courses; MSc, M.Biotech and MSc Nursing; MD, MS, MDS; MCh and DM (including direct six-year courses); PhD; fellowships.
